topic: The 'a raise will push me into a higher tax bracket and shrink my paycheck' myth. Using 2024 federal brackets for a single filer, a $5,000 raise on a $60,000 salary crosses into the 22% bracket, yet the extra federal income tax is only about $925. The worker keeps roughly $4,075 of the $5,000, before payroll tax and state tax. Fix: say yes to the raise or overtime, then check your W-4 withholding with the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator today.
